title: diqds: certification limits, trusted-randomness accounting and finite-size thresholds for device-independent quantum digital signatures
description: Code, cached results and tests for the article on device-independent quantum digital signatures (simulation only: NumPy/SciPy bounds, QuTiP, Qiskit Aer, SeQUeNCe). Every table and figure of the article is produced by the scripts in scripts/; results/article_numbers.json lists every number quoted in the text.
